card.name: Every, in dosing and monitoring intervals
card.fires_on: The word "every" (or "a" or "weekly") right after "once" or "at least" when a dose or test repeat interval is being given, such as every 24 hours or every 3 months.

modes.label: Every after once or at least
modes.description: "every" begins a repeat interval for a dose or a test.
modes.example: administer ethambutol hydrochloride 15 mg/kg (7 mg/lb) of body weight, as a single oral dose once<< every>> 24 hours.

modes.label: Other interval words
modes.description: Words like "a" or "weekly" that start a repeat schedule for monitoring.
modes.example: Perform an electrocardiogram (ECG) prior to the initiation of REVUFORJ, at least once<< a>> week for the first 4 weeks,

card.writes: It promotes words meaning "every time" or "always", which push the text toward recurring-interval wording.
card.plain: It marks the word that begins how often something is repeated, like "every 3 months" in testing or dosing instructions.
